boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Purchase tickets at the Murphy Fine Arts Center (MFAC) ticket office located at the front entrance (on the 2nd floor) of the MFAC located at 2201 Argonne Drive. Monday-Friday: 10am-6pm Sat: 10am-4pm Closed Sundays (except when there is a Sunday event—for which ticket office opens two hours prior to event). For nighttime events, the ticket office remains open until intermission of the event.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will call tickets may be picked up beginning one hour prior to event at MFAC box office (located at the MFAC main entrance). Customers must present the credit card used to purchase the tickets as well as a photo ID.

venues.parkingDetail: Free, off-street parking is available in the parking lot marked “Y-Lot.” Access lot by turning right onto McCallum Dr. (on left side of MFAC). Travel up hill, pass the 'X' Parking Lot (PERMIT PARKING ONLY) on right. At end of 'X' Parking Lot, bear right at black fence. Look for 'Y' Parking Lot-which is the general parking lot for Murphy Fine Arts Center events. As you walk toward the building, enter the MFAC through bank of doors (in the that face the plaza)

generalInfo.generalRule: Late Seating: To ensure minimal disruption to our patrons once a performance has started, latecomers will be seated at the discretion and direction of the Front of House Manager during an appropriate break in the performance. generalInfo.childRule: Everyone--regardless of age--must have a ticket. Please keep in mind that many performances and events are not appropriate for babies and young children.

boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: If you are picking up your tickets at will call, you must provide a photo I.D. that matches the name on the ticket envelope.

venues.parkingDetail: There are pay lots, garages, as well as street parking all around CFG Bank Arena.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: ADA seating is available through Ticketmaster.com. For questions regarding Accessible Seating at CFG Bank Arena, please email: adaseating@cfgbankarena.com or call (410) 347-2020.

generalInfo.generalRule: What is the bag/purse policy? A CLEAR BAG POLICY is in effect to enhance existing security measures and expedite venue entry at CFG Bank Arena. Approved bags include: • Clear bags that measure no larger than 14inch x 6inch x 14inch are permitted. • Small clutches/purses/wallets are permitted provided they do not exceed 4.5inch x 6.5inch and do not have to be clear. • Medical bags will be permitted and must be screened before entry. Prohibited bags include: Any and all bags that do not meet the criteria above including items such as grocery totes, mesh or straw bags, backpacks, duffle bags, diaper bags*, camera cases, and any other bags that the Arena staff deem to not meet the clear bag policy. *Items normally carried in a diaper bag must be placed into a clear plastic bag for entry. For more venue information please visit the CFG Bank Arena website for the A-Z Arena Guide. https://www.cfgbankarena.com/a-z-guide/
generalInfo.childRule: For concerts every patron requires a ticket, no matter what age. For family shows and sporting events, please check event information for each event.
